inputs.CL3: C1aF1 (primary, task item 2) and C1a (item 1 cross-check), runs/<ARM>/R, 18 runs each, server_segment from CL3 analysis/<NAME>.json
inputs.C2p: CL2 runs/C2p/R 18 runs (arms scope served) - binding / worst-row counts and item 4 re-query

definitions.sphere_model: build_constraint_robot_model(links=arms|gripper, capsule_radius_scale 0.05, sphere_spacing 0.4, max_spheres_per_capsule 32, finger_cover both) = CL2 C2p / CL3 server flags; arms 422 spheres, gripper 270

windows.close_seq: first server chunk (by seq) with grasp.state == 'closing' (CL3 analyze_cl definition; CL3 analysis pre_grasp.close_seq; C2p recomputed from server records)
windows.lift: close_seq < seq <= close_seq + 4, runs with analysis grasp == true only
windows.carry: close_seq + 4 < seq <= chunk seq containing release_t_robust (else place_t, else last chunk), runs with analysis grasp == true only
windows.policy_active: record target_permission.policy == exclude_authorized AND target_permission.held is null AND has_target AND esdf_free layer recorded (reported per window; the LTE / global difference can only exist in these chunks)

definitions.distance: sphere surface to GT fruit surface = exact Euclidean distance from the sphere centre to the convex hull of the fruit's MuJoCo collision meshes (inside: max facet-plane distance, negative) minus sphere radius; fruit pose from the full MuJoCo qpos of the control row (executed) or the planning row (planned rows)

geometry_sets.executed: every control row (8 per chunk) of the chunk, measured MuJoCo qpos (physical state)
geometry_sets.planned: server-record refined_chunk rows 0..15 (plan horizon 16) from the planning-row qpos (fingers at their current joint value)

definitions.criterion_item1_degenerate: gripper scope: number of non-authorized query rows (record target_permission.target_field_exclude == false) with sphere-surface-to-target <= 50 mm in policy-active chunks of the windows; 0 => degenerate. Field cross-check: non-authorized rows where |d_full - d_target_free| > 1 fine voxel (5 mm) and min(d_full,d_free) - r <= 50 mm
definitions.criterion_item2_approach: a non-authorized link approaches the target in a run if >= 1 chunk in the window has min over (steps, spheres of that link) of sphere-surface-to-target <= 50 mm. Primary window = pre8close (policy-active window); lift / carry reported. Primary geometry = executed; planned reported.
definitions.item4_verdicts: field-level re-query on planned rows 0..15 (and 0..7): no_exemption = every row reads the full field; global_exclusion = every row reads the target-free composition; LTE = authorized rows target-free, others full. Row violates at threshold m if d - r < m, m in {0, 10 mm (obstacle_margin), 50 mm (full target margin)}; a chunk diverges if >= 1 row has different violate flags under global vs LTE
definitions.to_time_estimate: linear in constraint spheres between CL2 C1bp (270 spheres) and C2p (422) server medians (T44e-CLA Q2_to_time_all_chunks_server_records); estimate only, no re-solve
definitions.stop_rule: single offline run; if no candidate set meets criterion 2 -> 'DX-04 비교 불성립'

fidelity.note_numbers: sphere centres of planned row 0 vs recorded sphere_centres max 0.21 mm (all chunks); recorded clearance vs re-query: arm / palm rows <= 5.2e-05 mm, finger rows up to 26.3 mm in closing / latched chunks (finger joint path not replayed)
